title: AIquidity
tagline: AIquidity is an AI-powered liquidity pool advisor that connects with MetaMask for automated fund management, risk optimization, and time-saving execution. The AI acts as a smart wallet, managing liquidity and executing transactions on behalf of users. 🚀
description: AIquidity offers a smart, AI-driven liquidity pool advisor that seamlessly connects with MetaMask, allowing users to automate fund management, optimize risk, and execute transactions effortlessly. By acting as an autonomous wallet, AIquidity eliminates manual complexities, enhances capital efficiency, and maximizes returns, making DeFi liquidity management simpler, smarter, and more profitable.
how_its_made:
For this project, I used a combination of CDP AgentKit, Wagmi.js, Base, Next.js, and Shadcn UI to build an AI-powered DeFi yield farming bot.

Technologies & How They Work Together:
CDP AgentKit: This serves as the AI-powered automation layer, allowing the bot to analyze DeFi opportunities and execute trades based on market conditions. It helps optimize yield farming strategies without manual intervention.
Wagmi.js: Acts as the service integration layer, handling wallet connections and smart contract interactions seamlessly. This simplifies on-chain transactions like staking, swapping, and liquidity provisioning.
Base (L2 Chain): Chosen for its low fees and fast transactions, making it ideal for yield farming automation. The bot executes trades and interacts with DeFi protocols on Base, ensuring cost efficiency.
Next.js & Shadcn UI: The frontend is built using Next.js for fast performance and server-side rendering, while Shadcn UI provides a clean and minimal design for a smooth user experience.
Partner Technologies & Benefits:
Base’s L2 scalability allowed the bot to perform frequent transactions at minimal gas costs.
AgentKit’s AI-driven automation enhanced yield farming by making data-driven trade decisions in real time.
